I am Viacheslav Bogdanov, an architect and full-stack engineer building
developer tools, automation systems, and practical AI-assisted engineering
workflows.

This site is my technical notebook for work that benefits from a durable public
write-up: performance investigations, implementation notes, product-quality
trade-offs, reproducible benchmarks, and lessons from building tools that run
in real CI/CD pipelines.

## Current Focus

- Fast developer tooling for large repositories.
- AI-assisted coding workflows that still need deterministic quality gates.
- Native CLI tools with practical compatibility, low installation friction, and
  clear release gates.
- Engineering choices that reduce maintenance cost instead of increasing it.
